• With the help of a graph, explain how temperature affects enzyme activity.
  • Temperature significantly impacts enzyme activity, with enzyme activity
  • generally increasing as temperature rises until an optimal point, after which it decreases
  • due to denaturation. This relationship can be visualized as a bell -shaped curve where the
  • peak represents the enzyme's optimal temperature.
questions.final_answer: peak represents the enzyme's optimal temperature.

questions.question: Evaluate the structure, properties and functions of major phospholipids.
questions.solution_html:
• Phospholipids are amphipathic lipids containing glycerol, fatty acids, phosphate and
  • nitrogenous base
  • Major phospholipids
  • Phosphatidylcholine (lecithin)
  • Phosphatidylethanolamine
  • Phosphatidylserine
  • Sphingomyelin
  • Properties
  • Amphipathic nature with hydrophilic and hydrophobic regions
  • Form bilayers in aqueous systems
  • Act as emulsifying agents
  • Functions
  • Major structural components of cell membranes
  • Involved in membrane fluidity and permeability
  • Function in lipid transport and signaling
  • Important in nerve tissue and lipoprotein structure
questions.final_answer: Important in nerve tissue and lipoprotein structure
